loc: Lagoíña do Carreirón ,Illa de Arousa, Pontevedra, Galicia
rmk:
Aínda hai algo de luz as 22.30 na  lagoiña do Carreirón, unha pequena lagoa anular no sur da  Illa de Arousa. O día foi despexado e morno (24º C) pero a esta hora  da noite, por mor dos ventos do nordés, temos uns 18ºC .  As Relas (Hyla molleri), no primeiro plano ,dominan  a escea coas súas chamadas territoriais . No fondo, o son afrautado e monótono do Moucho de orellas mestúrase co ronroneo contínuo da Avenoiteira e as chamadas intermitentes do grilo da braña (Pteronemobius heydenii). Nun momento pasa voando unha parella de lavancos  reais (3:46).  Adornan  as altas frecuencias as chamadas do Merlo e os últimos cantos do día do Paporroibo.

There is still some light at 10:30 p.m. in the Carreirón lagoon, a small annular lagoon in the south of the Illa de Arousa. The day was clear and warm (24º C) but at this time of night, due to the northeasterly winds, we have about 18ºC. The frogs (Hyla molleri), in the foreground, dominate the scene with their territorial calls. In the background, the fluty and monotonous sound of the Scops Owl mixes with the continuous purring of the Nightjar. At one point a pair of Mallards fly past (3:46). The high frequencies are adorned by the calls of the Blackbird and the last songs of the day of the Robin.
